title: Today’s task: share the accountable representation agenda
summary: Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan), NDC candidate for Yewa North/Imeko-Afon, asks supporters to share his commitment to transparent, year-round representation — oversight, feedback, and accessibility to every ward.

title: NDC uploads Peter Obi’s name to INEC portal amid appeal
summary: NDC National Leader Seriake Dickson says the party has uploaded Peter Obi’s name to the INEC candidate portal and filed an appeal against a court ruling, assuring supporters the process continues.

title: 97 days to go: mobilize one voter today
summary: Election day is 97 days away — 16 January 2027 at 9:00am. Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan), NDC candidate for Yewa North/Imeko-Afon, asks supporters to talk to one person who needs a PVC and share the reminder so the constituency is ready.

title: Are we cursed or are we the cause? — Peter Obi’s Independence message (trending)
summary: NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi’s Independence Day speech continues to trend. He asks hard questions about Nigeria’s path and reaffirms that a New Nigeria is possible. Watch and share.
